title: Tshingwana e e Nyeletseng ka Bosigo Bongwe
intro: Akanya ka tshingwana e e tlhogang, e e tletseng maungo a a butswang mme e dikologilwe ke ditlhare tse di kwa godimo. Ba ba neng ba e tlhokomela ba ne ba ipona ba le botlhale, ba rulaganyetsa thobo ya bone mo diureng tse di didimetseng pele ga mahube, kgakala le matlho a ba ba tlhokang. Mme Ene yo o sa robaleng o ne a na le maano a mangwe a bopelotshweu jwa bone jo bo fitlhegileng. A o ka fopholetsa gore ke mang yo o emeng ka fa morago ga kgang eno e e tlhagisang e e tswang mo Quran?
clues: Re kile ra bo re na le tshingwana e e neng e le matlhatsa e bile e le ntsi mo e leng gore botlhe ba ba neng ba feta ka yone ba ne ba e fufegela.
Fa re ntse re rulaganya, re ne ra sebasebana go sa le phakela, re bolela gore ga go na moya ope o o tlhokang o o neng o tla letlwa go tsena mo letsatsing leo.
Re ne re le batho ba ba humileng, mme dipelo tsa rona di ne di foufetse mo ditshwanelong tsa bahumanegi ba ba re dikologileng.
Fa mahube a thobo e re neng re ikaeletse go e roba a goroga, re ne ra atamela tshingwana ya rona fela go fitlhela e fetogile marope a a ntshofetseng ka bonako fela.
Taelo e e senyang e ne ya gogola, ya se ka ya tlogela sepe fa e se molora fela fa ditlhopha tsa maungo a a boduleng di kileng tsa bo di lepeletse gone.
Kgang ya rona ke tlhagiso e e bogale e e kwadilweng mo Quran, mo re itsiweng jaaka beng ba tshingwana ba ba neng ba thibela batlhoki dithuso.

identity.label: Ke Mang?
options: Beng ba Tshingwana
Batho ba Logaga
Barutwa ba ga Isa
Balekane ba Dikgong
Baeng ba ga Ibrahim

trial.label: Teko/Tiragalo
options: Go roba maungo mo sephiring le go thibela bahumanegi
Go robala makgolokgolo a dingwaga mo teng ga logaga
Go gana go dira kamela e namagadi ka letlapa
Go obamela namane ya gouta kwa Thabeng ya Sinai
Go aga araka e kgolo go falola morwalela
trial.answer: Go roba maungo mo sephiring le go thibela bahumanegi

location.label: Elemente ya Botlhokwa
options: Tshingwana e e ageletsweng ka lobota e e tletseng ditlhare tsa mokolane le tsa mofine
Legaga le lentsho kwa tengteng ga dithaba
Motse o o tlhasetsweng ke setsuatsue sa bomodimo
Mokgatšha o o boitshepo gaufi le Ntlo ya ga Allah
Dintshi tsa noka e e elelang
location.answer: Tshingwana e e ageletsweng ka lobota e e tletseng ditlhare tsa mokolane le tsa mofine

outcome.label: Botso
options: Tshingwana e ne ya jewa ke taolo e e fisang e e tswang kwa legodimong
Ba ne ba robala ka kagiso dingwaga di le 309 tsa ngwedi
Ba ne ba thubaganngwa ke pula ya matlapa .
Ba ne ba nwela ka fa tlase ga makhubu a morwalela o mogolo
Ba ne ba phatlaladiwa ke phefo e e tsididi e e bogale
outcome.answer: Tshingwana e ne ya jewa ke taolo e e fisang e e tswang kwa legodimong

arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
verse: Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew. (68:33)
